desc: Très réputée en ingénierie, informatique, IA et business. Campus moderne et immense.

name: Xi’an Jiaotong University
desc: Xi’an Jiaotong University is a major public research university in Xi’an, Shaanxi Province, China. It is one of the oldest and most prestigious universities in the country, renowned for engineering, management, and medical education. The university plays a leading role in the national “Double First Class” and former “Project 985” and “Project 211” initiatives

name: Zhejiang University
desc: Zhejiang University (ZJU) is a leading comprehensive public research university located in Hangzhou, China. It is one of China’s oldest and most prestigious higher education institutions, renowned for its rigorous academic standards, innovation, and interdisciplinary research strength.
